resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org and Oregon Lookouts say the tower was removed in 1963; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1963. The year agrees, so the story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Oregon Lookouts files the 1958 and 1959 items under Stump Springs; the link to this lookout is an inference from the same forest, the same era and the 1963 removal. No source describes the site today and no access data was found, so access is omitted. The sources give the tower as a 32' platform tower; the design field uses that as written and no height_m is set. Sources: 2 page reads of firetower.org and firelookout.com, 2 reads of Oregon Lookouts; one web search.
